dishes.name: Chiemsee Renke
dishes.desc: Lake whitefish from the nearby Chiemsee, fried in butter 'Müllerin' style with lemon. The classic fish of the Chiemgau.

dishes.name: Bavarian beer soup
dishes.desc: Beer-based soup thickened with cream and egg yolk, served with cheese-topped bread slices. An old Upper Bavarian recipe.

dishes.name: Kaiserschmarrn
dishes.desc: Fluffy torn pancake with raisins and powdered sugar, served with plum compote. A fixture on alpine-style menus in the Chiemgau.

dishes.name: Auszogne
dishes.desc: Fried yeast pastry with a thin centre and thick rim, dusted with sugar. An Upper Bavarian fair and bakery treat.

dishes.name: Butternudel
dishes.desc: Handmade Chiemgau noodles tossed in browned butter, a nearly forgotten mountain-inn speciality.
